verdict.rationale: Clerk documents first-party webhooks that deliver event notifications such as user created or updated (clerk-docs-5). Billing webhook events are also documented (clerk-docs-25), and the official CLI relays webhook deliveries to a local handler with offline signature verification (clerk-docs-38), which makes subscribing practical for programmatic consumers. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and detail on the event catalog and endpoint registration in the evidence.
